summary_en: Full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 raised by 2 yen per share to 106 yen, with year-end dividend adjusted to 63 yen per share after deducting interim dividend of 43 yen, reflecting strong operational progress and special gains from affiliate share sales.
title_en: Notice regarding revision of forecast for year-end dividend (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief:
Seino Holdings announced on November 12, 2026, that its Board of Directors has revised the dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The annual dividend per share has been increased by 2 yen to 106 yen. The year-end dividend forecast has been adjusted to 63 yen per share, calculated by subtracting the already-paid interim dividend of 43 yen from the revised annual amount.

The company's basic dividend policy targets a DOE (dividend on equity) of 4.0% or higher and includes an interim dividend payment. The revision reflects strong progress in operational performance during the first half of the fiscal year and the recognition of special gains from the sale of affiliate shares announced on October 30, 2026. This adjustment maintains the company's commitment to shareholder returns as a key management priority.
